Priest/Thaumaturgy.description: Homebrew melee / short-range support DPS Priest wielding a one-handed weapon and an off-hand item. Crushing Strike and persistent Mind Flay / Mind Sear tethers generate Insight. Mind Blast spends all Insight to create an independent single-target damage vulnerability; Shadow Word: Death extends every active weakness on its target. Mastery: Exploit Weakness separately stores a portion of your damage as a bonus-damage reserve for eligible contributors. First talent draft, not a complete or balanced tree. Unagreed values are marked TBD. Class, hero and Apex sections are unchanged.

nodes.name: Mastery: Exploit Weakness
nodes.description:
Your damage builds an Exploitation reserve on its target equal to [Mastery %] of the damage dealt.

Whenever you or an eligible ally damages that target, the reserve inflicts additional damage equal to the triggering hit, up to the amount remaining. This additional damage is attributed to you and normally consumes an equal amount of reserve.

Additional applications add to the reserve. Mastery-generated damage, echoes, stored-damage detonations and retaliation cannot build or trigger the reserve. This reserve is separate from Mind Blast's percentage damage vulnerability. Contributor eligibility and scaling above five players remain subject to the specialization's draft support rules.

nodes.name: Crushing Strike
nodes.description: Strike an enemy with your one-handed weapon, dealing damage and generating Insight. Damage, Insight generated and cooldown are TBD.

nodes.name: Mind Flay
nodes.description:
Establish a psychic tether to one enemy, dealing periodic Shadow damage and generating Insight for its duration. The tether persists while you move and use other abilities; it is not a conventional channel.

Mind Flay provides 100% of the baseline tether damage and Insight generation. Applying Mind Flay replaces your existing Mind Flay or Mind Sear tethers. Duration, tick rate, short casting range, break distance, Insight generated and cooldown are TBD.

nodes.name: Close Examination
nodes.description: Draft proposal: Crushing Strike generates additional Insight against enemies affected by your Mind Flay or Mind Sear. Additional Insight is TBD.

nodes.name: Mind Blast
nodes.description:
Consume all available Insight to expose a weakness in one enemy, increasing the damage it takes from eligible contributors for a duration. Weakness strength scales with the Insight consumed.

Each cast creates a separate weakness with its own strength and timer. A new cast does not replace, refresh or weaken previous applications. This ability is single-target and does not spread weakness.

Draft stacking rule: your active weakness percentages add rather than multiply. Direct damage, strength per Insight, duration, short range, cast time, cooldown and behavior at zero Insight are TBD.

nodes.name: Mind Sear
nodes.description:
Establish psychic tethers to up to three enemies. Each tether deals 40% of Mind Flay's periodic damage and generates 40% of its Insight over the same duration and tick schedule. Three active targets provide 120% combined damage and Insight generation.

You can move and use other abilities while the tethers persist. Applying Mind Sear replaces your existing Mind Flay or Mind Sear tethers. Mind Sear does not spread Mind Blast weaknesses. Target selection, short casting range, break distance and cooldown are TBD.

nodes.name: Perfect Understanding
nodes.description:
When Mastery: Exploit Weakness triggers, retain a portion of the reserve that would normally be consumed, without reducing the additional damage dealt.

Draft interaction: the retained portion scales with the target's total active Mind Blast weakness percentage, up to a limit. Bonus damage remains limited by the reserve available before the trigger. Retention scaling and its cap are TBD and must remain below 100%.

nodes.name: Reserve Judgment
nodes.description:
Store all your current Insight, emptying your resource bar so you can build Insight again. Your next Mind Blast consumes both stored and currently available Insight to determine the strength of its new weakness.

Only one bank can be held. Draft limit: stored Insight cannot exceed one normal resource bar. Bank duration, cooldown and behavior when recast with an existing bank are TBD.

nodes.name: Shadow Word: Death
nodes.description:
Deal Shadow damage to one enemy and extend every active Mind Blast weakness you have applied to it, preserving each application's strength. Expired weaknesses are not restored.

This specialization talent modifies the class ability rather than granting a second copy. Damage, extension amount, short range, cooldown and maximum extension rules are TBD.

nodes.name: Moment of Clarity
nodes.description: Reset the cooldowns of Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death. This does not generate Insight or create weaknesses by itself. Cooldown, cast time and interaction with any future charge talents are TBD.

nodes.name: Lay Bare
nodes.description:
Temporarily amplify your Mind Blast damage vulnerabilities. Draft scope: both existing weaknesses and weaknesses created during this effect benefit. When Lay Bare ends, surviving weaknesses return to their normal strength; the amplification is not stored permanently.

This amplifies percentage vulnerability, not the Mastery reserve. Amplification, duration and cooldown are TBD.

nodes.name: Exploiter
nodes.description: The target of your Unvail Weakness gain 20% more Exploit Weakness

nodes.name: Aura of Decay
nodes.description: Every 5 seconds, enemies within 15 feet of you gain an Exploitation reserve equal to 2% / 4% of their current health, up to 100% / 200% of your spell power per enemy per pulse.

nodes.name: Crusing Soul
nodes.description:
If you have 5 or more Insight, consume 5 insight to grant the target (5000%sp) exploit weakness.

Can trigger 1 every minute

designNotes.status: First sliced talent draft: ten new talents plus the established Mastery. Descriptions only, not implemented combat mechanics or a balanced complete tree. Working names, layout and connections are provisional.
designNotes.identity: Melee / short-range support DPS Priest using a one-handed weapon and an off-hand item. Understand enemies through psychic tethers, build Insight in melee, then spend it to expose weaknesses. Not an allied-stat buffer.
designNotes.baselineSpells: Shared Priest class abilities remain unchanged. Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death specialization nodes describe specialization behavior for the corresponding class abilities, not duplicate buttons. Mind Sear is now an enemy tether, not the previous Communion ally-link ability. Class-node prerequisite enforcement remains open.
designNotes.resource: Crushing Strike and tethers generate Insight. Mind Blast spends all available Insight; Reserve Judgment lets the next Blast spend banked plus current Insight. The resource cap, generation, mana costs, cooldowns, cast times and zero-Insight casting rule are TBD. Fractional tether generation must preserve Mind Sear's 40% per-target ratio.
designNotes.tetherRules: Mind Flay tethers one enemy at 100% effect. Mind Sear tethers up to three enemies at 40% damage and Insight generation each, using the same duration and tick schedule. They are mutually exclusive and persist while moving or casting other abilities. Tethers do not automatically spread Mind Blast weaknesses. Target selection, break distance, shared versus separate cooldowns and retargeting behavior are TBD.
designNotes.supportScope: Up to five eligible player contributors receive full support effectiveness; effectiveness decreases above five. Exact eligibility, whether the Priest counts toward five, pet ownership rules, the dilution formula and application of scaling to the Mastery reserve are TBD. The prior two-ally Communion restriction is superseded.
designNotes.weaknessRules: Every Mind Blast creates an independent single-target percentage damage vulnerability whose strength depends on Insight spent. Applications retain separate timers; later Blasts do not replace or refresh earlier ones. Shadow Word: Death extends all your active applications on its target and never revives expired ones. Strength, duration, extension amount and extension limits are TBD.
designNotes.stackingAndLimits: Draft proposal: percentages from your concurrent Mind Blast weaknesses add rather than multiply. Multiple-Priest interactions, maximum total vulnerability and extension safeguards are not decided. The previous strongest-only family rule and flat 15% cap are not part of this draft.
designNotes.masteryRules: Your damage adds [Mastery %] to a target-local Exploitation reserve. Eligible hits trigger equal bonus damage, limited by available reserve, and normally consume that amount. Mastery-generated bonus damage cannot build or trigger reserves. Perfect Understanding retains part of the normal consumption without reducing the bonus hit; its proposed link to weakness percentage and its sub-100% cap require tuning. Damage accounting order relative to percentage vulnerability remains open.
designNotes.cooldownRules: Moment of Clarity resets Blast and Death without supplying resources. Reserve Judgment banks Insight for one combined expenditure. Lay Bare temporarily amplifies percentage vulnerabilities, not the Mastery reserve; its proposed amplification ends with its buff rather than being snapshotted permanently.
designNotes.openDecisions: Numerical tuning, direct damage coefficients, Insight cap, costs, short-range distances, cooldowns, charge behavior, vulnerability stacking approval, extension limits and contributor rules remain open. Close Examination and weakness-scaled Perfect Understanding are draft proposals. Class and hero sections are unchanged; Apex is preserved as an older draft and still references mechanics requiring later reconciliation. This tree no longer claims an exact Augmentation layout.
